items.title: An 'incalculable' number of corpses are in Venezuela's earthquake zone. People feel abandoned
items.description: On the ground in Venezuela death and desperation linger, but they are juxtaposed against miracle survival stories.

items.title: What would a house price fall mean for Australians?
items.description: After decades of growth Australian house prices are slowing. Here's what a fall could look like.

items.title: Albanese wants conference to 'showcase' Labor but not its AUKUS division
items.description: The prime minister declares the conference would be "a real opportunity to bring the whole Labor movement with us on our direction".

items.title: Ampol boss says fuel crisis shows why Australia's last refineries matter
items.description: Ampol's chief executive says the Iran conflict exposed Australia's fuel vulnerability and strengthened the case for keeping its remaining refinery operating.

items.title: 'A direct political attack job': MP lashes anti-abortion campaigner
items.description: Anti-abortion campaigner Joanna Howe has been called out for potentially breaching campaign financing laws, with one MP labelling her "attack" style as harmful and dangerous.

items.title: Live: Lamine Yamal's Spain faces Austria in World Cup knockout
items.description: Spain takes on Austria on Los Angeles for a place in the World Cup round of 16. Later on, Cristiano Ronaldo's Portugal faces Croatia and Switzerland does battle with Algeria. Follow live.

items.title: De Minaur cruises through to Wimbledon third round with straight-sets win
items.description: Australian Alex de Minaur has raced into the third round at Wimbledon with a straight-sets victory over tricky French veteran Adrian Mannarino.

items.title: Childcare safety loophole for educators breaching regulations
items.description: A loophole in the government’s new childcare safety legislation allows educators who have breached safety standards to continue operating.

items.title: Elon Musk's X argued Bondi attack video 'no worse than gore movie', commission hears
items.description: Elon Musk's X Corp is fighting the eSafety Commissioner on three different take-down orders of violent content, including the killing of Charlie Kirk.

items.title: Venezuela earthquake survivor pulled from rubble after eight days
items.description: A 43 year old man has been pulled from the rubble of a collapsed shopping centre after being trapped for eight days after earthquakes in Venezuela.

items.title: UK PM apologises over forced adoptions, calls practice a 'stain on history'
items.description: UK PM Keir Starmer has formally apologised for the British state's role in separating tens of thousands of unmarried mothers from their babies.

items.title: Vatican excommunicates members of right-wing breakaway group SSPX
items.description: The Vatican has excommunicated priests and lay Catholics who are part of a breakaway right-wing Catholic group that ordained bishops without Pope Leo's approval.

items.title: Lions hold on for win over Geelong in Kardinia classic
items.description: Brisbane Lions earn a second straight win over Geelong at Kardinia Park in a high-scoring epic, as the Lions jump into the top four.

items.title: Easter eggs or cloak-and-dagger? Deciphering the Taylor Swift wedding hype
items.description: Fans believe they know the when and where of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's upcoming nuptials, but much of the reported two-day extravaganza will likely be a cloak-and-dagger operation.

items.title: Maggie O'Farrell's 'angry' new novel reveals tragic toll of Ireland's Great Famine
items.description: The Academy Award-nominated writer dives into Irish history in Land, revealing how the Great Famine changed the country forever.

items.title: From meaty mushies to rhubarb, the best July produce on offer
items.description: Here are some of the best fruit and vegetables to look for as we head further into winter.

items.title: State cracks down on sale of potentially deadly 'nangs'
items.description: After a 7.30 investigation exposed the increasing dangers of nitrous oxide use, NSW  has announced reforms will come into place shortly.

items.title: PM's tennis match shows property tax fight isn't over
items.description: A mortgage broker forked out $16,500 on Canberra’s night of nights to take his grudge about budget tax directly up to the prime minister in a tennis match at the Lodge.

items.title: Christian Brothers granted pause on abuse victim payouts
items.description: The Christian Brothers religious order has been granted a moratorium on all civil claims against it, after arguing it was running out of money to pay victims of child sexual abuse.

items.title: Gina Rinehart and estranged kids to pay large legal costs after royalties trial
items.description: Mining billionaire Gina Rinehart and her two estranged children will have to pay a large chunk of the legal costs able to be recovered from a mammoth trial that determined the payment of royalties from some of Australia's most lucrative iron ore mines, a WA judge has ruled.

items.title: 'Robbing people using visas': Applicants shocked by sudden price hike
items.description: International students and families say they feel shocked and exploited after visa fees across dozens of categories rose on July 1 without warning, with some surging more than 200 per cent.

items.title: Kyiv 'night of horror' as at least 21 killed in Russian attacks across Ukraine
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy cut his Dublin trip short as the strikes trapped paramedics and drivers at an ambulance station.

items.title: Privacy Commissioner ordered to hand over report on Amex security failures
items.description: The Privacy Commissioner has been ordered by parliament to hand over a secret report detailing its investigation into American Express's technology security failures, after using gag orders and legal threats to keep it confidential.

items.title: Professor admits wanting university job to benefit his consulting firm
items.description: ICAC hears that John Dewar wanted his UOW appointment to benefit KordaMentha and his acknowledgement there could be a perception of a conflict of interest.

items.title: Pictures show interior of Trump's new Air Force One jet
items.description: The jet, gifted to the US government by Qatar, has been retrofitted, with Trump shaking off concerns over the cost.
